question: Return the full name and id of the actor or actress who starred in the greatest number of films.
gold_sql: SELECT T2.first_name ,  T2.last_name ,  T2.actor_id FROM sakila_1_film_actor AS T1 JOIN sakila_1_actor AS T2 ON T1.actor_id  =  T2.actor_id GROUP BY T2.actor_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
generated_sql:
WITH actor_film_counts AS (
    SELECT
        fa.actor_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fa.film_id) AS film_count
    FROM sakila_1_film_actor AS fa
    WHERE fa.actor_id IS NOT NULL
      AND fa.film_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY fa.actor_id
),
max_film_count AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(film_count) AS max_count
    FROM actor_film_counts
)
SELECT
    a.actor_id AS actor_id,
    a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS full_name
FROM actor_film_counts AS afc
JOIN max_film_count AS mfc
    ON afc.film_count = mfc.max_count
JOIN sakila_1_actor AS a
    ON afc.actor_id = a.actor_id
ORDER BY
    a.actor_id;

question: What is the full name and id of the customer who has the lowest total amount of payment?
gold_sql: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name ,  T1.customer_id FROM sakila_1_customer AS T1 JOIN sakila_1_payment AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id GROUP BY T1.customer_id ORDER BY sum(amount) ASC LIMIT 1
generated_sql:
WITH customer_payment_totals AS (
    SELECT
        p.customer_id,
        ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS total_payment_amount
    FROM sakila_1_payment AS p
    WHERE p.amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
),
lowest_total AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(total_payment_amount) AS lowest_payment_amount
    FROM customer_payment_totals
)
SELECT
    c.customer_id AS customer_id,
    c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name,
    cpt.total_payment_amount AS total_payment_amount
FROM customer_payment_totals AS cpt
INNER JOIN lowest_total AS lt
    ON cpt.total_payment_amount = lt.lowest_payment_amount
INNER JOIN sakila_1_customer AS c
    ON cpt.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY
    c.customer_id;

generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    m.Name AS medication_name
FROM hospital_1_Stay AS s
JOIN hospital_1_Prescribes AS p
    ON p.Patient = s.Patient
JOIN hospital_1_Medication AS m
    ON m.Code = p.Medication
WHERE s.Room = 111
ORDER BY m.Name;

question: Show all cities where at least one customer lives in but no performer lives in.
gold_sql: SELECT T1.City_Town FROM cre_Drama_Workshop_Groups_Addresses AS T1 JOIN cre_Drama_Workshop_Groups_Customers AS T2 ON T1.Address_ID  =  T2.Address_ID EXCEPT SELECT T1.City_Town FROM cre_Drama_Workshop_Groups_Addresses AS T1 JOIN cre_Drama_Workshop_Groups_Performers AS T2 ON T1.Address_ID  =  T2.Address_ID
generated_sql:
WITH customer_cities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        a.City_Town AS city
    FROM cre_Drama_Workshop_Groups_Customers AS c
    INNER JOIN cre_Drama_Workshop_Groups_Addresses AS a
        ON c.Address_ID = a.Address_ID
    WHERE a.City_Town IS NOT NULL
),
performer_cities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        a.City_Town AS city
    FROM cre_Drama_Workshop_Groups_Performers AS p
    INNER JOIN cre_Drama_Workshop_Groups_Addresses AS a
        ON p.Address_ID = a.Address_ID
    WHERE a.City_Town IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    cc.city AS city
FROM customer_cities AS cc
LEFT JOIN performer_cities AS pc
    ON cc.city = pc.city
WHERE pc.city IS NULL
ORDER BY
    cc.city;
